fields.Name: T282 - Home Pin Group Assignment via New Group
fields.Description: Exercises the group-selector '__new__' branch (AddPanelNewGroupName), getSelectedGroup(), and the PinGroups/GetPinsInGroup grouped-render path — pin grouping logic distinct from ungrouped pin creation.

InputDefinition.goal: You are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Go to the Home landing page (Home icon/logo or application switcher dropdown). In the 'Pinned' section click 'Add Pin' to open the slide-in panel. In the 'Add to group' selector, choose the '+ New group...' option and verify a text input appears for the new group name; type a group name (e.g. 'Test Group'). Then expand 'Applications' and click 'Pin' on any nav item. Close the panel and verify the Pinned section now renders a group header labeled with your group name (with a pin count) and the pinned card grouped beneath it. Success is that pinning into a newly-named group produces a grouped section on the Home page. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Selecting '+ New group...' in the group selector reveals a new-group name input
After pinning an item into the named group, the Pinned section shows a group header with that name and the item grouped under it
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
